prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: a separate straight-on cassette body material for the inserted state of a React portfolio player, later composited with precisely animated vector reels.
Input image: reference only for the blue transparent molded shell material, paper texture, screws and manufactured detail. Do not preserve its diagonal pose.
Primary request: create ONE photorealistic, premium, real compact audio cassette seen absolutely straight-on orthographic facing the flat broad front, not oblique. Landscape 1536x1024 canvas. Center the whole cassette with a modest transparent margin. Cassette front outer rectangle approximately x=100..1436 y=90..935, standard width-to-height ratio approximately 1.57. Strictly horizontal top and bottom, strictly vertical left and right, no tilt, no roll, no trapezoid, no visible left/right/top side face. Front face fills 87 percent of canvas width. Genuine transparent background, no glow, no black backdrop.
Material: same translucent cobalt blue molded plastic as reference, but soft pastel blue, modest realistic highlights, machined symmetrical screws, consistent shallow wall thickness, manufacturing details and correct lower guide holes.
Leave the upper and lower horizontal white paper labels completely blank. NO letters, no numbers, no sticker, no logo, no watermark.
CRITICAL COMPOSITING REQUIREMENT: the broad central reel viewing window between the two white paper labels must be a single EMPTY unobstructed pale blue transparent-looking internal cavity, WITHOUT reels, WITHOUT hubs, WITHOUT black tape coils, WITHOUT circular disks or spindle holes drawn inside it. We will add circular black coils and white toothed hubs ourselves as independent vector layers in code. Do not draw a tape ribbon across the center gap. The window should stretch horizontally between approximately x=260..1276, y=320..640, with a level top and bottom.
Lighting: soft studio light from upper left matching ivory/lavender desk aesthetic; realistic refined object, avoid excessive chrome glare and melted shapes. Maintain premium physical detail. Show only this front cassette material, not a complete screen, player, UI, text or multiple objects.
